answer: raven mints a single nontransferable walnut per operator per epoch of judged work; trellis binds every key with that beneficial controller to the same balance. Activating identity \(k\) burns \(k^2\) walnut: the tenth costs 100 walnut, requiring 100 further attested epochs, and ten cost 385 walnut overall. An honest debut pays a single walnut. Concurrent keys cannot speed minting or obtain separate balances.
